name: Call of the Storm and Call of the Wind do not stack (#5498)
contract: Call of the Storm (578311) tooltips 'Does not stack with Call of the Wind.'; Call of the Wind (804018) tooltips the mirrored clause. PR #4952 fixed Aegis-vs-Aegis and Aegis-vs-Call exclusivity but explicitly scoped Calls out; no spell_group row existed for either Call family, so both stayed active together, matching the report. The new spell_group 1171 (stack rule 2, exclusive from same caster) makes casting one remove the other on the same recipient.

steps.label: SETUP: Call of the Storm is applied
Clear the GCD from Call of the Storm
SETUP: Call of the Wind is applied
DISCRIMINATING: Call of the Wind removes Call of the Storm (fails today: both stay at 1)
Clear the GCD from Call of the Wind
SETUP: Call of the Storm is cast a second time
DISCRIMINATING: casting Call of the Storm again removes Call of the Wind
